horoscope: The Sun moves into your work and health sector today, dear Aries, for a stay of a month, bringing a theme of taking care of business to your life. Until September 22nd, the spotlight is on work, service, health, daily affairs, and personal habits or routines. You're taking more pride and interest in these things so that you're likely to want to improve them. It's a fine time of year for building, tweaking, and organizing your work in meaningful ways. Today, you could be reassessing some of your interests or passions before moving ahead. It may be best to aim to appreciate simple pleasures and comforts rather than give in to the feeling that you need more to be happy.

There’s a tendency to question some of your attachments today, dear Taurus, especially if they seem to be keeping you stuck or stagnant. A bit of reassessment can be good for you right now. The Sun heads into your romance and leisure sector today, encouraging you to have some fun as well! The Sun visits this area of your solar chart until September 22nd, and it's a month-long, expressive, creative cycle that encourages you to invest in more playtime. It's a show-and-tell house in your chart, so expressing your talents, abilities, and affections comes naturally in the period ahead. A stronger urge is with you to create, show others what you can do, experience and enjoy romance, and more fully enjoy life's pleasures.

A strong desire to put something behind you can lead to a hands-on approach to problem-solving right now, dear Gemini. There could be some frustration with communications, and circumstances may be such that you question a learning path or interest. If your life has become too busy with inconsequential things, you’ll be feeling that now as the Sun meets the South Node. Aim to look at a frustrating situation by taking a step back and seeing what has been blocking you. Later today, the Sun heads into your solar fourth house for a visit that will continue until September 22nd. You're taking more pride and interest in your domestic life, family, foundation, or closest ties now. In many ways, this is a time to anchor or nest on a psychological level. It's not the most adventurous or outgoing cycle in the Sun's journey through your solar chart, but it's a powerful period for gaining a stronger sense of self.

The Sun heads into your communications sector today, dear Cancer, and will visit until September 22nd. The month ahead is likely to be busy, with you more engaged with others but not always focused. You're taking more pride and interest in your personal environment, communications, and interactions with others, making it an excellent time to make improvements to these things. Studies or personal interests can grab your attention now. This cycle is more about discovery and branching out than specializing. It's a strong time for communicating, connecting, learning, and sharing. Today, circumstances may make it clear you need to let go of certain possessions or even attitudes toward business and money matters to move forward. Decluttering can be important and even empowering now.

Today, as much as you’d like to, it’s not easy to get motivated and get going on something independently, dear Leo. Perhaps the best way to handle this is to use extra energy to offer others help rather than wait for something to happen. There could be a bit of a blow to the ego if you are pushing too hard for your own agenda. The need to pay some homage to a partnership or partner may arise. Ideally, you discover creative ways to fulfill both your need to feel attached to something and your desire to branch out. Later today, the Sun ends its yearly transit of your sign, and you're symbolically moving on. You're likely to find the new Sun cycle, lasting until September 22nd, very grounding, and you should use this energy to focus on being more emotionally present in various areas of your life. This can also be a time for making the most of your natural talents and abilities. Opportunities may arise that have you taking charge of your income and valuables, although you're most likely creating them in the month ahead.

You might be reassessing a particular service or support you give others today, dear Virgo. There can be some tendency to seek the easy way out, but with special attention to this inclination and some mindfulness, you could very well learn where your heart is. Also today, the Sun enters your sign, beginning a month-long cycle ahead when you're especially noticeable and feel more in charge and capable. If you've been considering changes to the personal image you project, this is a superb time to do so. You have increased personal presence now. Make the most of this period by being positive and believing in yourself, as this is the start of a new solar year. As more attention comes your way until September 22nd, you quite naturally want to get your act together. You are more readily attracting what you need into your life now.

There’s some tendency to analyze a friendship or connection to a group today, dear Libra, especially in terms of whether it’s allowing you to move forward and grow. You might need to swallow your pride for the sake of a relationship that you want to keep. Also today, the Sun enters your solar twelfth house, where it will transit until September 22nd. This yearly, month-long cycle is strong for reflection, rest, and recollection. You are gathering your strength for busier times to come, but this isn't an idle time. In fact, you can actively reflect upon recent events and shed attitudes and situations that have run their natural course. It can be a time to connect with your more spiritual side, but you could also sometimes feel a little lost, unnoticed, or ignored until you understand the purpose of this period: recharge. This is a clean-up period on emotional or psychic levels, so aim to use it well!

While the mood is pleasant today, dear Scorpio, there is a tendency towards excess that you’d be wise to tame. You might question a particular project, plan, long-term goal, or even your current career path if you’re uncertain it’s genuinely doing you any favors. There may be the need to swallow your pride just for now, as it may be the best course of action. Also today, the Sun moves into your solar eleventh house for a stay of a month, until September 22nd, encouraging more interaction with friends, teams, groups, networks, or the community. Your interest in what makes you happy and how you fit in with others or contribute to the group increases in the weeks ahead. The focus is on collaboration and cooperation. This is a time when participating in some way can be satisfying, and when putting ego needs to the side in favor of group efforts can be helpful. This is a good period for building up momentum and inspiration.

You could be questioning certain beliefs, learning paths, or interests today, dear Sagittarius. You may need to take a slight blow to your ego over an opinion to grow and come into your own. In truth, it can bring you to a stronger position. It makes sense to consider whether your current projects and beliefs are benefiting and representing you. You’re regaining motivation and enthusiasm these days, and it’s best to build on authenticity. Also today, the Sun heads to the top of your solar chart for a stay in your performance sector until September 22nd. What you do and how you perform are in focus in this cycle. New responsibilities may arise during this period, or you may feel more ambitious and focused on achievement and goal-setting.

Circumstances may be such that you consider letting go of a bad habit, dear Capricorn, or you may face the need to make adjustments before pushing forward, possibly finance-related ones. The Sun begins its transit of your sector of adventure and spirit today, and will continue to influence this area of your solar chart until September 22nd. It's an excellent cycle in which to lift yourself above your usual routines, even in little ways, so that you can better consider the bigger picture. You are more adventurous and curious. You might do more studying, learning, and venturing out and about in the weeks ahead. Your aspirations and ideals are stronger driving forces in your life now.

The need to make adjustments and take steps to improve your situation can arise now, dear Aquarius. Socially, you might be questioning elements of a relationship in terms of whether or not it’s supporting your personal growth. Avoid taking on responsibilities that others should be handling themselves, or watch for relying too heavily on others when you’d be better off getting things done independently. Nevertheless, you are likely to feel needed today, and you readily lend others support. The Sun begins its transit of your intimacy sector today and will continue to influence this area of your chart until September 22nd. This time of year can bring self-transformation into focus as you seek to grow and evolve. There can be an increased determination to improve your life from the inside out now, and there can be changes both of the internal and external variety to prove it. The spotlight can be on intimate connections and sharing, or financial and emotional support. You're drawn to a relationship or project that motivates you and that you can explore in depth or connect with on a deeper level.

The Sun begins its transit of your partnership sector today, dear Pisces, and will continue to influence this area of your chart until September 22nd. You are drawn to others during this cycle, and a spotlight may fall on close friendships and partnerships. You can learn a lot about yourself and your life through others now, as they can provide a mirror to certain aspects of yourself that you haven't been clearly seeing until now. This is a time when compromise and negotiation tend to serve you best. Today, you may be questioning some of the things you do for work or in service to others. You may be better off slimming down your duties to focus on the most important ones.
